description: Search the live web through Tavily: title, URL, and snippet for each source of a natural-language query.
limitations: Snippets only, not a logged-in browser. Runs on the platform's Tavily key unless the organisation connects its own.
setup_hint: The platform's key serves every organisation while web search is on. Connect a Tavily API key to search on your own.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the live web. query is natural language. The result is title, URL, and snippet for each source.

prompt.guidance: When this run offers `tavily_search`, search the live web. `query` is natural language. The result is title, URL, and snippet for each source.
